headline: Sensex Slumps 700 Points, Nifty Falls Below 25,700 Dragged by IT and Auto Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex slump of 700 points dragging Nifty below the 25,700 mark.
Auto and IT sectors both declined by 1% during trading.
Major IT stocks such as Infosys, TCS, and HCLTech experienced sell-offs.
CLSA analyst sees low-teens limited upside for Nifty despite continuing FPI investments.
whatHappening: RBI Governor stated that only 20-30% of eligible Indian exports utilize FTA benefits.
Gold rebounded from a 15-month low, while silver prices surged nearly 6%.
SEBI Chairman emphasized minority shareholder protection regarding the Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal.
AirAsia delayed staff salary payments to the end of the month according to internal communications.
summary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed a sharp downturn today, with Sensex slumping 700 points and Nifty breaching below 25,700. The decline was primarily led by Auto and IT sector stocks including Infosys, TCS, and HCLTech. Elsewhere, SEBI noted that investor protection remains central in the Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal.
